exposure: no or little planning of pregnancy
cesarean section or vaginal delivery with episiotomy
feeling of sadness and lack of interest in life before delivery
outcome: signs and symptoms of Adjustment Disorder
cohort: 151 postpartum women in a public maternity hospital in Recife
finding: 7.94% of postpartum women presented with signs and symptoms of Adjustment Disorder related to childbirth.
mod_finding: Cesarean section or vaginal delivery with episiotomy were associated with Adjustment Disorder.
